clues.text: Daniel was told that seven weeks and sixty-two weeks would pass from the decree to rebuild Jerusalem until this one came.
In a vision explained to Daniel, this title appears alongside the title 'the Prince.'
Daniel heard that after the sixty-two weeks, this promised one would be cut off and have nothing.
After spending a day with Jesus, Andrew ran to his brother Simon saying they had found this one.
At a well in Samaria, a woman told Jesus she knew this promised one was coming.
A Samaritan woman said that when this promised one arrived, He would explain everything to her people.
When a Samaritan woman spoke of this promised one, Jesus answered, 'I who speak to you am He.'
